text.p: These are the leading stories in the Tunisian press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
-Algerian Prime Minister Ahmed Ouyahia on Sunday said at the end of a three-day visit in Tunis that a programme has been set up to boost bilateral cooperation.
-President Ben Ali says in a message at the occasion of the celebrations marking the 35th anniversary of Radio Sfax that information must reflect citizen's concerns.
